description: Export INSPIRE-HEP's citation entries for the papers a literature query selects, as BibTeX or LaTeX \bibitem entries (EU or US style), keyed by INSPIRE texkeys and ready to paste into a bibliography. Name specific papers with "recid:451647 or arxiv:1207.7214 or doi:10.1016/…", or export a topic, author, or citing set with any query cern_inspire_search_literature accepts. Up to 50 entries per page; page through larger sets (only the first 10,000 matches are reachable). Entries are INSPIRE's verbatim text (long author lists arrive abbreviated as "First, Name and others").

document_types.description: Restrict to INSPIRE document types (up to 4). Multiple values must ALL hold (published + review = published reviews), not either. Values: article, published, conference paper, thesis, review, note, proceedings, lectures, book chapter, book, introductory, activity report, report.

format.description: Entry format: bibtex (default), latex-eu, or latex-us (\bibitem entries in European or US style).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. page × size may not exceed 10,000.

query.description: Literature query selecting the papers to cite, narrowed by the same document_types, subjects, year_from and year_to filters as search. Named papers: "recid:451647 or arxiv:1207.7214 or doi:10.1016/j.physletb.2012.08.020". Or a topic ("t higgs and topcite 500+"), an author ("a Edward.Witten.1"), or citing papers ("refersto:recid:451647"). Empty recognized field clauses such as "a:" are invalid; other syntax is passed through without complete grammar validation. See cern_inspire_list_reference topic search_syntax.

sort.description: Entry order: relevance (default), mostrecent, or mostcited.

subjects.description: Restrict to INSPIRE subject categories (up to 4). Multiple values must ALL hold, not either. Values: Astrophysics, Phenomenology-HEP, Theory-HEP, Quantum Physics, Unknown, Gravitation and Cosmology, Experiment-HEP, Theory-Nucl, Accelerators, Instrumentation, General Physics, Experiment-Nucl, Math and Math Physics, Condensed Matter, Computing, Lattice, Other, Data Analysis and Statistics.

year_from.description: Earliest year to include (1900–2100, inclusive), matched on the earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper. Omit for no lower bound.

year_to.description: Latest year to include (1900–2100, inclusive), matched on the earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper. Omit for no upper bound.

name: cern_inspire_export_citations

entries.description: Citation entries, in the requested order.

texkey.description: INSPIRE texkey (the \cite key), e.g. Maldacena:1997re; empty when INSPIRE gives none.

text.description: The entry, verbatim as INSPIRE serves it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_year_range`: year_from is later than year_to. `beyond_result_window`: page × size exceeds the 10,000 results INSPIRE serves for one query. `invalid_query`: A recognized field clause has no value, or INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, or was JSON or HTML where citation text was expected. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextPage.description: The page number to request next, when more papers follow within the 10,000-result window.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the last or came back empty inside the match count, more papers follow, or the page could not be checked against the match count.

shown.description: Number of entries on this page.

truncated.description: True when more matched papers follow this page.

title: Export INSPIRE citations
